description.default: Install any version from GitHub links — faster, and no marketplace wait. Marketplace PRs work too, covering plugins, themes, icons, widgets and templates; list local packages to toggle or batch-check updates, and view repo summaries, releases and install history.
description.zh-CN: 不等集市上架，用 GitHub 链接装任意版本集市包，比官方集市更快一步。也支持从集市 PR 直接安装；涵盖插件、主题、图标、挂件、模板五类包，能集中列出本地包一键启停、批量查更新，还可查看仓库摘要、Release 信息与安装历史。
